source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 1 同主题完形(我的机器人助手/设计一个AI装置/参观机器人科学展/写科幻故事/智能厨房/太空殖民的梦)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一、选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: My Robot Helper
passages.text: Last year my family bought a small robot helper named Max. At first I did not (1)____ it much, because I thought it would be useless. But Max soon proved how (2)____ it was. Every morning it would (3)____ my schoolbag and remind me of the day's lessons. When my grandmother forgot her glasses, Max would quietly (4)____ them for her. It could even (5)____ how long my homework might take. Of course, Max was not perfect. Sometimes it gave (6)____ answers that made us laugh. My father said that any machine like this (7)____ be tested carefully before we fully trust it. Still, I have grown to (8)____ Max as a real member of the family. It has changed the (9)____ of our daily life, giving us more free time. I now believe that helpful robots are not just (10)____ in stories; they are already here.

how useful it was 多有用。

find them for her 帮她找到。

ridiculous answers 荒谬的回答(下文 made us laugh)。

the pace of our daily life 生活节奏。

passages.title: Designing an AI Device
passages.text: For our science class, we had to (1)____ our own AI device and present it to the others. My group chose to build a small flying helper called Sky. exactly look like 究竟长什么样。

passages.title: A Visit to the Robot Fair
passages.text: Last weekend our class went to a big robot (1)____ held in the city centre. The venue was huge, and thousands of visitors (2)____ in to see the latest machines. The first robot we met could (3)____ a chess game better than any human player. Another one was able to (4)____ how the weather would change over the next week. passages.title: Writing My Own Sci-Fi Story
passages.text: Our teacher asked each of us to write a short science (1)____ story for the class magazine. I decided to write about a girl who builds a time (2)____ in her bedroom. At first I found it hard to (3)____ what time travel would feel like. So I closed my eyes and tried to (4)____ the strange sights in my mind. In my story, the moment the girl pushed the (5)____, the walls of her room seemed to fall away. Days and nights passed (6)____ and faster, until she arrived in a far future city. There she met a friendly robot that could (7)____ her language. Writing the story (8)____ me hours, but I enjoyed every minute. passages.title: The Smart Kitchen
passages.text: My uncle has turned his kitchen into a fully smart (1)____. As soon as he walks in, the lights come on by (2)____. If something starts to burn, an alarm is (5)____ at once, and the heat is turned down. My uncle says the robot must (6)____ be cleaned after each meal, just like ordinary tools. The best part is that boring kitchen (7)____ is now done by the machine, so my uncle has more time to relax. Of course, he still (8)____ to cook special dishes himself, because he enjoys it. He believes that good technology should help people, not (9)____ them. Thanks to his smart kitchen, family dinners have become easier and far more (10)____.

questions.explanation: a smart room 智能房间(厨房)。
by itself 自动地(灯自己亮)。
measure how much 量取多少。
mix the ingredients 把原料混合。
an alarm is sounded 警报响起。

passages.title: Dreaming of Space
passages.text: Ever since I was a child, I have (1)____ of travelling to a distant planet.
